title: Fixed Open Base Router Plane
description: One newly authored whole fixed router-plane-inspired woodworking tool. A single wide low horseshoe-like sole has a real large open front throat. Its raised rear bridge carries a complete rectangular through-bored collar; one full upright iron turns into a forward-facing finite blunt L foot just above the ground datum. A separate short rear clamp screw fixes the iron in the displayed pose. Two whole shaped lateral walnut knobs and their seated fasteners complete the broad two-hand silhouette. This is not the old long 45-degree bench plane with another handle: no sloped frog, inclined long iron, lever cap or rear open tote is used. All visible whole geometry is new; only generic mesh/export/render tools are reused. Three opaque constant PBR materials, closed editable bodies, metres, Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred grounded sole. One fixed visual tool, zero scenes. The blade/collar clearance and fixed clamp are illustrative; no depth adjustment, cutting, shaving, sharpness, flatness, workpiece fit, hand ergonomics, manufacturing tolerance, load or tool-safety claim.
